gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Chai Wan Road running northwestwards for a distance of approximately 290 metres and terminating at the temporary Chai Wan Public Transport Terminus as shown coloured green on Drawing No. HH 3985A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點與柴灣道街口連接，向西北伸展約二百九十米，至柴灣臨時公共汽車總站終止。其位置在HH 3985A號圖則上用綠色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing from the temporary Chai Wan Public Transport Terminus and running southeastwards for a distance of approximately 135 metres as shown coloured yellow on Drawing No. HH 3985A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點在柴灣臨時公共汽車總站，向東南伸展約一百三十五米。其位置在HH 3985A號圖則上用黃色標明。

history.submitter_remarks: Printed EN Sheung On Road; corrected to Sheung On Street by G.N.1031.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with the thoroughfare referred to in (b) above, running southwestwards for a distance of approximately 85 metres to its junction with the thoroughfare referred to in (a) above as shown coloured blue on Drawing No. HH 3985A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點與上文(乙)段所述街道之街口連接，向西南伸展約八十五米，再與上文(甲)段所述街道之街口連接，其位置在HH 3985A號圖則上用藍色標明。
